text.tspan: Mean income per month within the richest decile (before tax) 1968 to 2024
Mean income per month within the richest decile (tenth of the population). This data is adjusted for inflation and
differences in living costs between countries. Income here is measured before taxes and benefits.

tspan.tspan: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
